ciAndroidEvidence.scope: aapt/apksigner receipts in GitHub-digest-verified artifact; APK bytes independently matched to the build receipt

nativeAudio.source: git show <exact sourceCommit>:assets/audio/<filename>; not working-tree files

scopeLimits: Original GitHub ZIP digest/size, source/run and CI receipt identity verified; no APK rebuild or modification.
Standalone AAPT2 independently resolves the exact three Git audio resources. Signature and Android badging receipts are checked against the original artifact; no local apksigner invocation.
No Android installation, native process-kill, physical file erasure, microphone, sound, push delivery, accessibility or complete multi-account marketplace E2E.
No production signing/AAB, Google Play distribution, paid AI probes or release readiness certification.
R06 runtime flag UNKNOWN and retention/source/export/erasure gates remain open; the status-only fix does not close the entire R06 lifecycle.

method.loadCriterion: Each LOAD p_align >= 0x4000; additionally check p_vaddr and p_offset congruence modulo 0x4000.
method.relroExplicitCriteria: End address modulo 0x4000 = 0 OR end equals end of LOAD containing RELRO start. No absent RELRO in this APK.
method.relroPaddingTreatment: Two actual ELF RELRO MemSiz ranges extend beyond the LOAD that contains their start. They are separately reported, not silently counted as the explicit equality formula. For each RELRO, inspect every writable LOAD for overlap outside RELRO within [floor(start/16384)*16384, ceil(end/16384)*16384). Zero such overlap is a static observation, not a runtime compatibility claim.
method.zipCriterion: Actual ZIP_STORED .so data offset = local header offset + 30 + local filename bytes + local extra bytes; modulo 16384 checked. Local name/method checked against central directory.

limits: Static program-header and numerical native ZIP offset inspection only; not zipalign or the unavailable historical QA94 checker.
The two padded RELRO variants require separate interpretation; no blanket RELRO or full 16 KB compatibility PASS is asserted.
No Android emulator/physical-device run, 16 KB startup, audio test or app-process-kill test.
No AAB/bundletool/Play-generated split inspection. General non-native ZIP alignment not checked.
